description: Fetch a single backbone taxon by its GBIF taxon key. Returns full classification, authorship, taxonomic status, vernacular name, descendant count, and publication reference. Use after gbif_match_species when you need the complete record rather than the match summary. When taxonomicStatus is SYNONYM, acceptedKey and accepted fields identify the accepted taxon. The extinct field is absent (not false) on most records — only present on explicitly flagged taxa.

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key from gbif_match_species or another taxonomy tool.

name: gbif_get_species

accepted.description: Scientific name of the accepted taxon when this record is a synonym.

acceptedKey.description: Backbone key of the accepted taxon when this record is a synonym.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The taxonKey does not exist in the GBIF backbone. `invalid_filter`: GBIF rejected the taxonKey as unparseable — a fraction, or a value outside the 32-bit signed integer range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

extinct.description: True when the taxon is explicitly flagged as extinct. Absent on most records.

numDescendants.description: Count of child taxa in the backbone under this taxon.

parent.description: Name of the immediate parent taxon.

parentKey.description: Taxon key of the immediate parent.

taxonomicStatus.description: ACCEPTED, SYNONYM, DOUBTFUL, etc. SYNONYM means acceptedKey/accepted are populated.

title: Get Species Record
